sw_museum_kid: We come every year and every year it is the rock.
I have written FORTY KINDS OF ROCK four times now.
The good case is at the back and we are never allowed to the back.

lines: The girl at the far case. Nine days.
She asked me on the second day whether the museum had a fire plan.
Not what to do in a fire. What we would carry out. Nobody has ever asked me that.
Do not touch the glass, do not lift the wheel, and do enjoy yourself.
In that order. The wheel is the one everybody argues about.
